blurb.en: One class, two dogs, and proof that changing one of them leaves the other alone.
blurb.zh: 一个类、两条狗，外加一个证明：改其中一条，另一条纹丝不动。

en: A class is a blueprint and an instance is one thing built from it. Dog("Rex", 3) does two jobs in one go: it makes a new, empty object, then runs __init__ on it to fill it in. You never call __init__ yourself; writing the class name with brackets is how you ask for it.

self is not a keyword, it is simply the first parameter of every method, and Python fills it in for you. rex.describe() is really Dog.describe(rex): the object before the dot is passed in as self. That is how one describe method, written once, can talk about Rex on one call and Fido on the next.

Everything stored on self belongs to that one object. rex and fido each get their own name, their own age and, crucially, their own tricks list, because __init__ runs once per object and builds a fresh list every time. The last line prints False for rex is fido: two objects built from the same class are still two objects.
zh: 类是图纸，实例是照图纸造出来的一个东西。Dog("Rex", 3) 一次做两件事：先造一个新的空对象，再对它运行 __init__ 把它填好。你从来不自己调 __init__——写出类名加一对括号，就是在要它。
self 不是关键字，它只是每个方法的第一个形参，而且由 Python 替你填上。rex.describe() 实际上就是 Dog.describe(rex)：点号前面的那个对象被当作 self 传进去。所以只写了一次的 describe，这一次说的是 Rex，下一次说的就是 Fido。
存在 self 上的一切都只属于那一个对象。rex 和 fido 各有自己的名字、自己的年龄，最要紧的是各有自己的 tricks 列表——因为 __init__ 每造一个对象就跑一次，每次都新建一张列表。最后一行 rex is fido 打出 False：同一个类造出来的两个对象，仍然是两个对象。

lineNotes.en: A new empty list per dog, because this line runs once for every object. Contrast class-vs-instance-attributes, where a list written in the class body is shared by all of them.
lineNotes.zh: 每条狗一张新的空列表，因为这一行每造一个对象就跑一次。对照 class-vs-instance-attributes：写在类体里的列表是所有对象共用的。

lineNotes.en: Assigning to an attribute of one object changes that object only. rex.age is still 3 on the next line.
lineNotes.zh: 给一个对象的属性赋值，只改那一个对象。下一行里 rex.age 仍然是 3。

run.expect:
Rex is 3 and knows 2 tricks
Fido is 5 and knows 0 tricks
['sit', 'roll over'] []
3 6
Dog False

blurb.en: Two ways for an object to describe itself: one for the person reading the output, one for the programmer debugging it.
blurb.zh: 对象描述自己的两种方式：一种给看输出的人，一种给调试程序的人。

en: Without either method, print(book) shows something like <__main__.Book object at 0x10f3a2d90>: the class name and a memory address that changes every run. It tells you almost nothing, which is why nearly every class you write for real ends up with at least a __repr__.

__str__ is for people. print() and str() and a plain {book} inside an f-string all ask for it. __repr__ is for programmers: it should be unambiguous, and where possible it should look like the code that would rebuild the object. That is why the title appears in quotes in the repr and not in the str - the quotes tell you it is a string and not a variable name.

Look at the fourth line of output. Printing a list shows the repr of each item, not its str, even though you called print. Containers always use repr for their contents, so a class with only __str__ still prints as the unhelpful default when it sits inside a list. If you only write one of the two, write __repr__: when __str__ is missing, Python falls back to __repr__, but never the other way round.
zh: 两个方法都不写时，print(book) 打出来的是 <__main__.Book object at 0x10f3a2d90> 这样的东西：类名加一个每次运行都不同的内存地址。它几乎什么都没告诉你——这就是为什么你真正写的类几乎都至少带一个 __repr__。
__str__ 给人看。print()、str()、f-string 里普通的 {book} 要的都是它。__repr__ 给程序员看：它要没有歧义，能做到的话最好长得像能重新造出这个对象的代码。所以书名在 repr 里带引号、在 str 里不带——引号告诉你那是一个字符串，而不是一个变量名。
看输出第四行。打印一个列表时，显示的是每个元素的 repr 而不是 str，哪怕你调用的是 print。容器对自己的内容永远用 repr，所以只写了 __str__ 的类一旦放进列表，打出来还是那个没用的默认样子。两个只写一个的话，写 __repr__：缺 __str__ 时 Python 会退回去用 __repr__，反过来则不会。

lineNotes.en: A list asks each item for its repr, so both books appear in their developer form here.
lineNotes.zh: 列表向每个元素要的是 repr，所以这里两本书都以给开发者看的样子出现。

lineNotes.en: Inside an f-string, !r asks for the repr instead of the str. The __repr__ method above uses the same conversion on each field.
lineNotes.zh: 在 f-string 里，!r 表示要 repr 而不是 str。上面的 __repr__ 方法对每个字段用的正是同一个转换。

run.expect:
Dune (412 pages)
Dune (412 pages)
Book('Dune', 412)
[Book('Dune', 412), Book('Emma', 474)]
Dune (412 pages)
Book('Dune', 412)

blurb.en: A counter every student shares on purpose, and a list every student shares by accident.
blurb.zh: 一个所有学生有意共用的计数器，和一张所有学生无意中共用的列表。

en: A name assigned in the class body, outside any method, is a class attribute: there is exactly one of it, stored on the class. A name assigned on self inside a method is an instance attribute: each object has its own. When you read obj.name, Python looks on the object first and, only if it is not there, on the class. That lookup order explains every line of this program's output.

The counter is updated through the class name on purpose. Reading through self would find the class attribute, but assigning through self never changes the class: it quietly creates a new attribute on that one object, which from then on hides the shared one. The last line shows exactly that: ben.count = 99 gives Ben a private count, while Student.count and ann.count still say 2.

clubs is the trap. It is a class attribute holding a list, and join() never assigns to self.clubs - it calls append on it. append changes the one shared list in place, so a club Ann joins shows up for Ben and for the class as well. The fix is what subjects already does: create the list inside __init__, so each student gets a new one.
zh: 在类体里、任何方法之外赋值的名字是类属性：它只有一份，存在类上。在方法里挂到 self 上的名字是实例属性：每个对象各有一份。读 obj.name 时，Python 先在对象上找，找不到才去类上找。这个查找顺序解释了本程序输出的每一行。
计数器是有意通过类名去改的。通过 self 去读，确实会找到类属性；但通过 self 去赋值永远改不到类：它会悄悄在这一个对象上新建一个属性，从此把共用的那个挡在身后。最后一行演示的正是这件事：ben.count = 99 让 Ben 有了一份私有的 count，而 Student.count 和 ann.count 仍然是 2。
clubs 是那个陷阱。它是一个装着列表的类属性，而 join() 从来没有给 self.clubs 赋值——它是在它身上调 append。append 就地修改那一张共用的列表，所以 Ann 参加的社团，Ben 和类身上也都冒了出来。修法就是 subjects 已经在做的：在 __init__ 里建列表，每个学生各得一张新的。

lineNotes.en: One list, created once when the class is defined, and shared by every Student that ever exists.
lineNotes.zh: 一张列表，在定义类的那一刻建一次，此后存在过的每个 Student 都共用它。

lineNotes.en: self.clubs finds no instance attribute, so it falls through to the class list, and append mutates that shared list.
lineNotes.zh: self.clubs 在实例上找不到，于是落到类上那张列表，append 改的就是那张共用的列表。

lineNotes.en: Assignment through an instance creates an instance attribute. It shadows Student.count for Ben only.
lineNotes.zh: 通过实例赋值会新建实例属性。它只对 Ben 一个人挡住了 Student.count。

blurb.en: The balance can only move through methods that check the amount first, and outside code can read it but not set it.
blurb.zh: 余额只能经由先检查金额的方法变动；外面的代码读得到它，却设不了它。

en: Encapsulation means the object guards its own data. Nobody outside should be able to set a balance to -500 or deposit a negative amount; the only doors in are deposit and withdraw, and both refuse bad amounts before touching anything. They return True or False so the caller can see whether the change happened. (A later page, py-files-errors, shows the other common answer: raising an exception.)

Python has no truly private attributes. The leading underscore in _balance is a convention that says "internal, do not touch", and the last line of the program proves it is only a convention - acc._balance can still be read. Exam pseudocode often marks attributes private; in Python, the underscore plus a read-only property is how that intention is written.

The property decorator turns a method into something read like an attribute: acc.balance, with no brackets, runs the method and returns its result. Because no setter was defined, the property has no way to be assigned - the fifth line of output checks that its fset is None - and acc.balance = 1000 would fail with an AttributeError.
zh: 封装就是对象自己看守自己的数据。外面谁都不该能把余额设成 -500，或者存进一笔负数；进来的门只有 deposit 和 withdraw 两扇，而且两扇门都先拒掉不合法的金额，再去碰余额。它们返回 True 或 False，让调用方看得出这次改动到底有没有发生。（后面的 py-files-errors 页会讲另一种常见做法：抛异常。）
Python 没有真正私有的属性。_balance 开头的下划线是一个约定，意思是「内部用，别碰」；程序最后一行证明它只是约定——acc._balance 照样读得到。考试的伪代码常把属性标成 private；在 Python 里，这个意图就写成「下划线 + 只读 property」。
property 装饰器把一个方法变成像属性一样读的东西：acc.balance 不带括号，就会运行那个方法并交回结果。因为没有定义 setter，这个 property 根本没有被赋值的途径——输出第五行检查的就是它的 fset 为 None——acc.balance = 1000 会以 AttributeError 失败。

lineNotes.en: Both refusals in one test: a non-positive amount, or more than the account holds. Nothing below runs unless both are false.
lineNotes.zh: 两种拒绝写在一个判断里：金额不为正，或者超过账户里有的钱。两者都不成立，下面才会执行。

lineNotes.en: Looked up on the class, balance is the property object itself. Its fset is the setter, and there isn't one.
lineNotes.zh: 在类上查，balance 就是那个 property 对象本身。它的 fset 是 setter，而这里没有。

blurb.en: A Student is a Person with a school: reuse the parent's constructor, inherit one method untouched, and extend another.
blurb.zh: Student 是多了一所学校的 Person：复用父类的构造方法，原样继承一个方法，再扩展另一个。

en: Writing Person in round brackets after the class name says a Student is a Person. Every method Person defines is available on a Student without being written again: s.greet() works even though Student never mentions greet. That is the whole point of inheritance - shared behaviour lives in one place.

Student needs its own __init__ because it has an extra field, and the moment it defines one, Person's __init__ no longer runs by itself. super().__init__(...) calls it explicitly so name and age are still stored by the code that owns them. Forget that line and s.name raises AttributeError the first time anything reads it.

describe is overridden, but not thrown away: the Student version calls super().describe() and adds to its result. Overriding replaces a method; calling super() from inside the replacement is how you extend it instead. isinstance confirms the relationship runs one way only - a Student is a Person, a Person is not a Student.
zh: 类名后面的圆括号里写上 Person，意思是：Student 是一种 Person。Person 定义的每个方法，Student 不用再写一遍就能用：Student 一个字都没提 greet，s.greet() 照样能跑。这就是继承的全部意义——共有的行为只放在一个地方。
Student 需要自己的 __init__，因为它多一个字段；而它一旦定义了自己的，Person 的 __init__ 就不会再自动运行。super().__init__(...) 显式地调用它，让 name 和 age 仍由拥有它们的那段代码来存。漏掉这一行，第一次有人读 s.name 时就会抛 AttributeError。
describe 被覆盖了，但没有被扔掉：Student 版调用 super().describe()，再往它的结果后面加东西。覆盖是替换一个方法；在替换版里调用 super()，就变成了扩展。isinstance 证明这个关系只朝一个方向成立——Student 是 Person，Person 不是 Student。

lineNotes.en: greet is not in Student at all. Python finds it by looking in the parent class.
lineNotes.zh: Student 里根本没有 greet。Python 是去父类里找到它的。

lineNotes.en: True then False: every Student counts as a Person, but a plain Person is not a Student.
lineNotes.zh: 先 True 后 False：每个 Student 都算 Person，但普通的 Person 不是 Student。

run.expect:
Sam, 40
Ava, 17, studies at Hill College
Hi, I am Ava
True False
True

blurb.en: total_area makes the same call on everything it is given, and each object answers in its own way - including one that is not a Shape at all.
blurb.zh: total_area 对交给它的每个东西发同一个调用，每个对象各按自己的方式回答——包括一个根本不是 Shape 的对象。

en: Polymorphism means one call, many behaviours. total_area never asks what kind of thing it has; it calls area() and trusts the object to know. A Rectangle multiplies, a plain Shape falls back to the default 0, and adding a new shape later needs no change to total_area at all.

Plot does not inherit from Shape - the last line prints False for isinstance - yet total_area accepts it without complaint. Python does not check types when a method is called; it only checks that the method exists. This is duck typing: if it has an area() method, it can be measured. (A plot of 2 acres is about 8094 square metres, at 4047 per acre.)

Exam pseudocode usually shows polymorphism through inheritance, and the first two objects do exactly that. Duck typing is the Python addition: the shared parent class is a convenience that documents the contract, not a requirement for taking part in it. The price is that a missing method is only discovered when the call runs.
zh: 多态就是一个调用、多种行为。total_area 从来不问手里拿的是什么；它调用 area()，相信对象自己知道怎么算。Rectangle 做乘法，普通的 Shape 退回默认的 0；以后再加一种形状，total_area 一行都不用改。
Plot 并不继承 Shape——最后一行 isinstance 打出 False——可 total_area 照收不误。Python 调方法时不检查类型，只检查这个方法存不存在。这就是鸭子类型：只要有 area() 方法，就能被量。（2 英亩的地大约 8094 平方米，每英亩按 4047 算。）
考试的伪代码通常借继承来展示多态，前两个对象正是这样。鸭子类型是 Python 多出来的那一层：共同的父类是记录约定的一种方便，而不是参与约定的门票。代价是：少了哪个方法，要等调用真正执行时才会发现。

lineNotes.en: The default behaviour. Rectangle overrides it; a plain Shape() still uses it.
lineNotes.zh: 默认行为。Rectangle 覆盖了它；普通的 Shape() 仍然用它。

lineNotes.en: False: Plot is not a Shape, and total_area still worked on it.
lineNotes.zh: False：Plot 不是 Shape，而 total_area 照样处理了它。

blurb.en: A car is not a kind of engine, it has one - so it keeps an Engine inside and hands the engine's work to it.
blurb.zh: 汽车不是一种发动机，它有一台发动机——所以它把 Engine 装在自己里面，把发动机的活转交给它。

en: Inheritance models is-a: a Student is a Person. Composition models has-a: a Car has an Engine. The test is to say the sentence out loud. "A car is an engine" is false, so Car(Engine) would be the wrong design even though it would let car.start() work.

Car builds its Engine inside __init__ and keeps it as an attribute. From then on, anything engine-shaped is delegated: Car.start calls the engine's start and wraps the answer, and is_running just passes the engine's own answer back. Car adds what a car knows (its model) and nothing else.

The payoff is that the parts stay separate. You could swap Engine for an ElectricMotor with the same two members without touching Car, and Engine can be tested on its own. The last line shows the relationship precisely: the car is not an Engine, but the thing in car.engine is.
zh: 继承表达 is-a：Student 是一种 Person。组合表达 has-a：Car 有一台 Engine。检验方法是把这句话念出来。「汽车是一台发动机」不成立，所以 Car(Engine) 是错的设计——哪怕它确实能让 car.start() 跑起来。
Car 在 __init__ 里造出自己的 Engine，存成一个属性。从此凡是发动机的事都转交出去：Car.start 调用发动机的 start 并把回答包一层，is_running 直接把发动机自己的回答交回去。Car 只添上汽车才知道的东西（型号），别的一概不管。
好处是各个部件保持分离。你可以把 Engine 换成一个有同样两个成员的 ElectricMotor，Car 一行都不用动；Engine 也能单独拿出来测试。最后一行把关系说得很准：汽车不是 Engine，但 car.engine 里的那个东西是。

lineNotes.en: The state lives in the engine, not the car. Car only ever reads it through its engine attribute.
lineNotes.zh: 状态存在发动机里，不在汽车里。Car 只经由自己的 engine 属性去读它。

lineNotes.en: The inner object is still reachable. Chaining attributes like this walks from the car to the engine it has.
lineNotes.zh: 里面那个对象照样够得着。像这样连着点属性，就是从汽车走到它拥有的发动机。

run.expect:
False
Mini: engine started
True
136
False True

blurb.en: A small value class with its constructor, repr and equality all written out, so you can see what the dataclass version is saving you.
blurb.zh: 一个小小的值类，构造方法、repr、相等比较全部亲手写出来——好看清 dataclass 版替你省掉了什么。

en: Without __eq__, a == b compares identity: it is True only when both names refer to the very same object, so two points built from the same numbers would be unequal. Defining __eq__ replaces that with a comparison of the values, which is what a point should mean. a is b still prints False - is always tests identity, whatever __eq__ says.

Comparing two tuples compares them item by item, so one == does the work of checking x and y together. The isinstance guard comes first so that comparing a Point with something that is not a Point does not crash on other.x.

NotImplemented is a special value, not an error. Returning it tells Python "I do not know how to compare with this", and Python then tries the other object's __eq__ before giving up and treating them as unequal. That is why a == (1, 2) prints False rather than raising.
zh: 没有 __eq__ 时，a == b 比的是身份：只有两个名字指向同一个对象才为 True，于是由同样两个数造出来的两个点反而不相等。定义 __eq__ 就是把它换成按值比较——这才是「点」该有的意思。a is b 仍然打出 False：is 永远比身份，不管 __eq__ 怎么说。
两个元组相比较是逐项比的，所以一个 == 就把 x 和 y 一起查完了。isinstance 那道关放在前面，是为了让 Point 和别的东西比较时，不会在 other.x 上崩掉。
NotImplemented 是一个特殊值，不是错误。返回它是在告诉 Python「我不知道怎么和这个比」，Python 于是先去试另一个对象的 __eq__，都不行才当作不相等。所以 a == (1, 2) 打出的是 False，而不是抛错。

lineNotes.en: Not False and not an exception: a signal that lets Python try the other side before deciding.
lineNotes.zh: 不是 False，也不是异常：是一个信号，让 Python 在下结论之前先去试另一边。

lineNotes.en: Equal values, different objects. The dataclass version prints exactly the same line.
lineNotes.zh: 值相等，对象不同。dataclass 版打出的是一模一样的这一行。

run.expect:
Point(x=1, y=2)
True False
False
[Point(x=1, y=2), Point(x=3, y=4)]
False

blurb.en: The same point in a quarter of the lines: declare the fields, and the decorator writes the constructor, repr and equality for you.
blurb.zh: 同一个点，行数只剩四分之一：把字段声明出来，装饰器替你写构造方法、repr 和相等比较。

en: Put this next to point-plain-class. The main block is identical and so is every line of output, because the decorator generates an __init__ taking x and y in the order the fields are declared, a __repr__ in the Point(x=1, y=2) form, and an __eq__ that compares the fields in order and refuses objects of any other class.

The two field lines in the class body are annotations, not assignments: a name, a colon and a type, with no equals sign. They declare that the class has these fields; the decorator reads them to decide what to generate. The type written there is documentation only - Python will not stop you from building Point(1.5, "two"), just as it ignores the type hints on an ordinary function.

Use a dataclass when a class is mostly a bundle of named values. Write the methods by hand when construction needs checks or the repr needs a particular shape - and know what the generated versions look like, because the exam will expect you to write them out.
zh: 把它和 point-plain-class 并排看。主程序一模一样，输出也一行不差，因为装饰器生成了：一个按字段声明顺序接收 x、y 的 __init__，一个 Point(x=1, y=2) 样式的 __repr__，以及一个按顺序比较各字段、并且对别的类的对象一律不认的 __eq__。
类体里那两行字段是注解，不是赋值：名字、冒号、类型，没有等号。它们声明这个类有这些字段，装饰器读了它们才知道要生成什么。那里写的类型只起说明作用——你造 Point(1.5, "two")，Python 不会拦你，就像它不管普通函数上的类型提示一样。
一个类主要是一捆有名字的值时，用 dataclass。构造时需要检查、或者 repr 要特定样子时，就亲手写这些方法——而且要知道生成出来的版本长什么样，因为考试会要你把它们写出来。

lineNotes.en: The generated __repr__ at work inside a list, identical to the hand-written one.
lineNotes.zh: 生成的 __repr__ 在列表里发挥作用，和亲手写的那个一模一样。

lineNotes.en: The generated __eq__ only compares against another Point, so a tuple with the same numbers is not equal.
lineNotes.zh: 生成的 __eq__ 只和另一个 Point 比，所以数字相同的元组也不相等。

run.expect:
Point(x=1, y=2)
True False
False
[Point(x=1, y=2), Point(x=3, y=4)]
False

blurb.en: Four special methods, and u + v * 2 reads like the maths it stands for.
blurb.zh: 四个特殊方法，u + v * 2 就读得像它所代表的那道数学。

en: Every operator is a method call in disguise. u + v runs u.__add__(v), u * 2 runs u.__mul__(2), u == v runs u.__eq__(v), and abs(u) runs u.__abs__(). Define the method and the operator works for your class. Leave out __add__, __mul__ or __abs__ and +, * or abs() raises TypeError; leave out __eq__ and == does not fail but falls back to comparing identity, so a vector would equal only itself (as point-plain-class shows).
__add__ returns a new Vector and changes neither operand. That is what + means for numbers and strings too, and code that reads x = u + v would be very surprised to find u altered afterwards.

Operator precedence does not change just because the methods are yours: in u + v * 2 the multiplication still happens first. One thing does not come for free: 2 * u fails, because Python first asks int to multiply by a Vector and int does not know how. Supporting it needs one more method, __rmul__, which this program leaves out.
zh: 每个运算符都是一次乔装的方法调用。u + v 运行 u.__add__(v)，u * 2 运行 u.__mul__(2)，u == v 运行 u.__eq__(v)，abs(u) 运行 u.__abs__()。定义了方法，运算符就对你的类生效。没定义 __add__、__mul__ 或 __abs__，+、* 或 abs() 就抛 TypeError；没定义 __eq__，== 却不会报错，而是退回去比身份——一个向量只和它自己相等（见 point-plain-class）。
__add__ 返回一个新的 Vector，两个运算对象都不改。数字和字符串的 + 也是这个意思——写下 x = u + v 的代码，要是事后发现 u 变了，会非常意外。
方法是你写的，运算符优先级也不会因此改变：u + v * 2 里仍然先算乘法。有一件事不是白送的：2 * u 会失败，因为 Python 先去问 int 会不会乘一个 Vector，而 int 不会。要支持它得再加一个方法 __rmul__，本程序没有写。

lineNotes.en: The right-hand operand here is a plain number, not another Vector, so the parameter is named for what it is.
lineNotes.zh: 这里右边的运算对象是一个普通的数，不是另一个 Vector，所以形参按它的真实身份取名。

lineNotes.en: v * 2 happens first, giving Vector(2, 4), and then u is added to it.
lineNotes.zh: 先算 v * 2 得到 Vector(2, 4)，再把 u 加上去。

blurb.en: A second constructor that reads a date from text, and a leap-year helper that belongs with dates but needs no date to run.
blurb.zh: 一个从文本读出日期的备用构造器，和一个与日期有关、却不需要任何日期对象就能运行的闰年辅助函数。

en: An ordinary method receives the object as self. A class method receives the class itself, conventionally named cls, so it can be called before any object exists - which is exactly what a constructor needs. from_string turns "29/02/2024" into the three numbers __init__ wants and builds the object.

Building with cls rather than the name Date matters as soon as there is a subclass. SchoolDate adds nothing, yet SchoolDate.from_string returns a SchoolDate, as the last line shows. Had the method said Date(...), every subclass would get plain Date objects back from it.

A static method receives neither self nor cls. is_leap_year needs only a year, so it is really a plain function that has been put inside the class because that is where someone looking for it would look. It can be called on the class or on an instance, and behaves the same either way.
zh: 普通方法收到的是对象，叫 self。类方法收到的是类本身，按惯例叫 cls，所以它可以在任何对象存在之前被调用——构造器要的正是这一点。from_string 把 "29/02/2024" 拆成 __init__ 要的三个数，再造出对象。
用 cls 而不是写死 Date 来造对象，一旦有了子类就很要紧。SchoolDate 什么都没加，可 SchoolDate.from_string 交回来的是 SchoolDate，最后一行就是证明。如果方法里写的是 Date(...)，每个子类从它那里拿回的都只会是普通的 Date。
静态方法既不收 self 也不收 cls。is_leap_year 只需要一个年份，所以它本质上是一个普通函数，放进类里只是因为想找它的人会到这里来找。在类上调、在实例上调都行，行为完全一样。

lineNotes.en: split gives three strings, unpacked into three names. They are still text at this point; the next line converts them.
lineNotes.zh: split 得到三个字符串，解包进三个名字。此刻它们还是文本，下一行才转换。

lineNotes.en: 02d pads with a leading zero to two digits, so month 2 prints as 02.
lineNotes.zh: 02d 用前导零补足两位，所以 2 月打成 02。

lineNotes.en: Called on the subclass, cls is SchoolDate, so that is the class of the object built.
lineNotes.zh: 在子类上调用时 cls 就是 SchoolDate，造出来的对象也就是这个类。

blurb.en: Payment says every payment has a fee without saying what it is, and Python refuses to build any class that has not filled that in.
blurb.zh: Payment 规定每种付款都有手续费，却不说是多少；没有把这一项填上的类，Python 一律拒绝实例化。

en: An abstract class is a contract. Payment knows how to work out a total, but only in terms of a fee it cannot calculate itself. Marking fee as abstract says "every real payment type must supply this", and total can rely on it being there.

Card and Transfer each implement fee, so they can be built and used. Voucher inherits from Payment but supplies nothing, so it is still abstract, and so is Payment itself. __abstractmethods__ lists what is missing, and trying to build either one raises TypeError straight away - at construction, not later when fee is first called.

That early failure is the whole value. Without the abstract marker, Voucher(1000) would build happily and only break on the first call to total, perhaps far away in some other part of the program. try and except are used here only to keep the program running past the error so you can see it happen; the py-files-errors page is where they are explained. The error's own message is not printed, because its wording differs between Python versions.
zh: 抽象类是一份契约。Payment 知道怎么算总额，但只能借一个它自己算不出来的手续费来算。把 fee 标成抽象，就是在说「每一种真正的付款方式都必须提供它」，而 total 可以放心地依赖它一定存在。
Card 和 Transfer 各自实现了 fee，所以能造出来、能用。Voucher 继承了 Payment 却什么都没提供，所以它仍是抽象的，Payment 本身也是。__abstractmethods__ 列出缺的是什么；试图造其中任何一个，都会立刻抛 TypeError——在构造的那一刻，而不是等到第一次调用 fee 时。
这个「早早失败」就是全部价值。没有抽象标记的话，Voucher(1000) 会顺顺当当地造出来，直到第一次调用 total 才坏——而那可能远在程序另一个角落。这里用 try 和 except 只是为了让程序越过这个错误继续跑，好让你亲眼看到它发生；讲解它们的是 py-files-errors 页。错误自带的消息没有打印，因为它的措辞在不同 Python 版本之间不一样。

lineNotes.en: The abstract method has no body worth writing. Subclasses provide the real one.
lineNotes.zh: 抽象方法没有值得写的方法体。真正的实现由子类提供。

lineNotes.en: __abstractmethods__ is a frozenset; sorted turns it into a list so the output is the same on every run.
lineNotes.zh: __abstractmethods__ 是一个 frozenset；sorted 把它变成列表，好让每次运行的输出都一样。

lineNotes.en: Construction is the moment Python checks for unfilled abstract methods, so this line is where the TypeError comes from.
lineNotes.zh: 构造的那一刻，Python 检查有没有没填上的抽象方法，所以 TypeError 就出自这一行。

run.expect:
Card 1020
Transfer 1050
Payment ['fee']
Payment cannot be instantiated
Voucher ['fee']
Voucher cannot be instantiated
